|---|---|---|---|

## ErrorBody

The JSON body of every error response.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `error` | string | Yes | A stable, machine-readable kind. |
| `message` | string | Yes | What went wrong, for a person. |

## FieldSchema

One form field, as `/v1/pdf/forms/fields` lists them.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string | Yes | `text`, `checkbox`, `radio`, `choice`, `signature` or `button`. |
| `name` | string | Yes | Fully qualified name, such as `customer.name`. |
| `options` | array of string | Yes |  |
| `page` | integer | Yes | 1-based page of the first widget. |
| `value` | string | No |  |

## FontSchema

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `family` | string | Yes |  |
| `file` | string | Yes | The file's base name. |
| `mounted` | boolean | Yes | True when it came from the mounted fonts directory. |
| `style` | string | Yes |  |
| `weight` | integer | Yes |  |
| `id` | string | No | The stored font this face belongs to, for deleting it. Absent for fonts in the image or the mounted directory. |

## FontsStored

What an upload stored.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fonts` | array of StoredFontSchema | Yes |  |
| `skipped` | array of SkippedSchema | Yes | Files in the ZIP that were left out, and why. |
| `syncIntervalSeconds` | integer | Yes | In use on this replica now, and on the others within this many seconds. |

## StoredFontSchema

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `faces` | array of FaceSchema | Yes |  |

## Validation

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `diagnostics` | array of object | Yes | Every problem found: `severity`, `message`, and a `location` with `part`, `place` and `snippet` where known. |
| `engine` | string | Yes | The engine that would handle it: `office`, `text` or `none`. |
| `format` | string | Yes |  |
| `ok` | boolean | Yes | True when the template renders with the sample data. |
| `template_hash` | string | Yes | SHA-256 of the template, the cache key. |
| `error` | string | No | The first error, when `ok` is false. |
